derivation:
by
  simp only [doubleCoset, ← Set.image_singleton (f := e), ← Set.image_mul]
  simp [Set.mem_image, e.injective.eq_iff]
explanation: Unfolding doubleCoset, apply Set.image_mul twice to transport the product of three sets. Singleton-image simplification and injectivity give the membership equivalence.
